title: Full body · 16 September
label: 35-MINUTE STRENGTH SESSION
coachNote: 35 minutes total: 4 minutes warmup and light practice sets; 20 minutes for the first four exercises; 9 minutes for calf work; 2 minutes to finish and log. Use moderate loads with about 3 reps in reserve. Rest 60 seconds between sets, longer if needed. Choose loads from how warmup sets feel; previous entries are references, not a requirement to increase. Keep calf work controlled and stop if it causes pain. If time runs short, omit a final set rather than rushing.

exercises.name: 45° leg press
exercises.target: 2 sets × 10 reps · about 3 reps in reserve
exercises.note: Light practice set first. Record plates added and note whether your load includes the sled.

exercises.name: Dumbbell bench press
exercises.target: 2 sets × 10 reps · about 3 reps in reserve
exercises.note: Light practice set first. Record weight per dumbbell.

exercises.name: Cable row
exercises.target: 2 sets × 10 reps · about 3 reps in reserve
exercises.note: Light practice set first. Record the machine's displayed load.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Romanian deadlift
exercises.target: 2 sets × 10 reps · about 3 reps in reserve
exercises.note: Light practice set first. Record weight per dumbbell.

exercises.name: Standing calf raises
exercises.note: Use both feet on level ground, knees straight but not locked. Keep one hand on stable support and hold a light dumbbell in the other. Rise evenly, pause briefly, then lower slowly without bouncing. Record total added weight, excluding bodyweight. Start with bodyweight as a practice set.

exercises.name: Weighted wall-sit calf raises
exercises.equipment: Wall + light weight plate or dumbbell
exercises.target: 2 sets × 10 heel raises · light added weight
exercises.note: Back against the wall, feet hip-width, knees bent at a comfortable depth. Secure a light weight across the thighs, away from the kneecaps, using your hands. Keep hips against the wall; lift both heels evenly and lower slowly. One heel raise and lower is one rep, not seconds. Record total added weight. Use bodyweight if control or comfort changes.
